title: A code formed between formations
statement: Codes changed only by hearing keep agreement exactly through closed hearings; the start and the order fix the form reached; reading across holds where codes agree; no law privileging neither form nor formation settles a symmetric disagreement; imposed and written-back codes stay.

title: A coupling saturated by what it has carried
statement: Strengths read off what has passed through a coupling read the levels before; where they are zero once A has passed, the coupling stops by the step A has passed and a finite order is exact; it stops exactly where its response reaches zero, and floored at one it recurs.

title: A formation's own course
statement: Where what couples into a formation is read as values, being alike through its couplings up to a step is one prefix of its own course, a selection through them selects by that prefix, and own courses with at most N and N' states fix what it tells apart within N + N' - 1 steps, a bound attained.

title: A goal along a lineage
statement: A goal carried at each step passes down a lineage where it passes across each descent and each member keeps it until it gives; descendants of carriers carry it exactly where it passes across every descent from a carrier.

title: A history read off its finite stretches
statement: For every process, its histories are the ideals of the order of its finite stretches. Adhering is the least closed class; refutable and closed classes pass into each other up to a step that, asked of every process, is exactly double-negation elimination.

title: A law along one run, under a relation
statement: Under an equivalence, a law admits a run's steps up to a step exactly where steps alike under it, by the same move, end alike, and failure persists. Projection, changing coupling and fixed conditions are its readings; the image is exact exactly where alike configurations match steps.

title: A law through coupling that changes along the run
statement: Where what a formation depends on forms and dissolves along a run, the law at what it couples into on each occasion and the law at the coupling of one moment agree where nothing it depends on changes; otherwise neither gives the other.

title: A law through what a formation couples into, along one run
statement: What a formation couples into carries a law along one run exactly where the occasions it couples alike, by the same move, lead to occasions it couples alike; an uncoupled level can break this law in a determined process.

title: A narrowing above its widening
statement: A ranking of presentations puts a narrowing above its widening by one item only where it ranks that pair otherwise than its order on the kept sets does, or the item weighs at zero or below; read right, exactly where the item weighs below zero, and zero ties.

title: A need with a cap
statement: Where a need has a cap, levels keep a formation within its band between need and cap; with balance the band is exact on both sides, a part opening it from below by giving and closing it from above by giving beyond the margin to the cap.

title: A pattern outlasting its carriers lasts through passing
statement: A pattern present from T on whose carriers are brief for d lets no d consecutive steps pass without a carrier beginning (in double-negation form); under the passing premise it is passed across one of every d steps, one empty step ends it, and if passing stops it ends within d steps.

title: A pool read by its majority
statement: Taking what more than half the members read is a selection through the pooled coupling, separating no more than the pool; where more than half read alike on two histories it goes alike on them, however many members tell them apart: shares decide what it separates.

title: A pool that recruits through itself
statement: A pool's reach lasts with its members. A pool admitting its next members through its own pooled coupling never couples two histories apart exactly when the pool along the other never does: it comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would.

title: A race for position draws everything
statement: Drawers in turn, each ranking its position against what all draw, draw everything at every step wherever what stands from nothing is least and there are at least two; where something left would stop what stands next, a drawer keeps it to stop it.

title: A reading against the share does not ratchet
statement: Where the rule is read against the share and selection under a favouring rule does not lower the share, along a course whose rules favour the rule read at a later reading step is not above the rule read at an earlier one: the rise the lock rests on does not form.

title: A rise past the inflow is drawn from beyond
statement: Across every step of a balanced flow, a family rises by at most what flows into a family containing it and what is drawn from beyond; a rise past that inflow has a formation drawing from beyond, and a selection rewarding it favours that draw.

title: A source must arrive before the juncture
statement: Where a source has not reached a reader by D, a reader whose step at x is chosen from its answer read through its couplings takes the same step in both courses; where the chosen steps keep s in one course and lose it in the other, x is a juncture and the source has, not not, reached the reader.

title: A coupling a step keeps a dependence at every horizon
statement: A coupling added for each step a dependence stays met keeps it at every horizon where it covers the renewal forgone a step and exceeds the end; below the need the horizon's end breaks it, at the last step alone above that rate; below the rate a long horizon outweighs it.

title: A weighting falling faster than renewal ends the base
statement: Under an order weighting later draws less, every optimum gains at each step what a course of greatest weighted gain does; where the weighting falls faster than every positive level renews, every optimum ends its own base at the first step; where a level within reach renews faster, none does.

title: A whole carried by lasting parts
statement: Where from T on a part arises within every d steps and each arising part lasts d steps, the whole is active at every step from T + d on: the converse of a whole's needing its parts' arising, which needs the parts to last.

title: A whole of every part, and a graded whole
statement: A whole active while every part is ends as soon as one part ends; between it and a whole of some part, the grade of listed parts gains what arises and loses what ceases, so a whole of at least j of them arises and ceases only through one, and the whole is diminished where some are active, not all.

title: Acquired bindings enter compositional use
statement: For every word-by-word reading: where grouping recovers the words, reading every encoded sequence gives the meanings of its words exactly when each word is read as its meaning. For acquired lexicons: wherever the transition record groups the two-word encoding (six local bond conditions), interpreting every encoded sequence equals the assembly of its atoms exactly when each word form resolves to it

title: Acquired goal revision enters a pending task
statement: For every partial law with counted work, a pending task finishes in exactly its remaining work plus one tick, every shorter run leaves it pending, and, pending and delivered being exclusive, no shorter run delivers it. Under the existing versioned-delivery invariant, rewriting the head packet's remaining encoding preserves its captured route, progress and other work, so the revised head is again s

title: The additive part of the variance in offspring number
statement: The squared covariance of offspring number with any carried amount is at most the product of their variances, counted over pairs: Fisher's additive part through the amount is at most the whole variance, all of it where the amount is offspring number itself.

title: Alignment approaches under the selection laws
statement: Every alignment approach deciding through couplings selects alike all beyond its deciders' closures, premise-free; under the continuation condition a preference-coupled approach is thus incomplete whatever its raters value, and C asks only what every order counting everything shares.

title: AI alignment direction under widening and the practical commitments
statement: With warranted AI correspondence, the practical principles support generative development, revision, transfer and appropriate ending while retaining capability growth’s real benefits and losses.

title: Any number of drawers in turn
statement: With any number of drawers in turn from two, each ranking courses, every profile at a mutual best response at every step from every level has every drawer leave nothing, so the base stands at once at what stands at nothing; two drawers are the case.

title: Arising needs change
statement: A formation active exactly where it is supported does not arise across a step at which its requirements do not grow and its needs and every level stay: what does not change gives no arising.

title: Assured arrival in the three-route process
statement: For every determined process (each move has at most one successor), a plan completes — every step possible and safe from every configuration the earlier steps can reach, every endpoint meeting the goal — exactly when it runs, its run is safe and its endpoint meets the goal; with no safety condition, exactly when it runs and every endpoint meets the goal. For a law of change, a plan completes exact

title: Attraction is not returning
statement: Every determined law draws exactly what does not return; what can be had n steps on absorbs every lost possibility, and two merged configurations do not both return. Attraction is merging in finitely many configurations, not in an open world; entering an invariant region of a process locks in.

title: Balance from conservation along a relation
statement: Over finitely many relata, transfers between related relata that balance a step exist exactly where the total is conserved on every family the relation closes, and a law reading only related relata that conserves its total gives that conservation.

title: Balance from the first law
statement: A quantity carried only by the exchanges taking part balances the levels exactly where no condition produces it. Read in available work, the first law and the entropy balance give balance where no store generates entropy, and the exchanges' exergy balance: balance and least loss from one reading.

title: Bands of the three powers and heights
statement: The bands of the three powers (first and second, third and fourth, fifth and top) and the heights are two divisions of the places: together they fix a place, neither is a function of the other, and each band spans one seam, the band of man the junction of the halves.

title: The priority of basic conditions, step by step
statement: Read with the sustaining formation's events as the basic tier, the priority of basic conditions (J1) ranks the absence of a malignant formation above its occurrence under the stepwise and relation-level readings, where C alone leaves them unranked.

title: Basins of a determined law
statement: Under any determined law, courses meeting is an equivalence whose classes are basins; a course reaches every returning configuration of its basin, so within finitely many configurations each basin holds one cycle, entered before as many steps as there are configurations.

title: Coherent histories across retained and changing contexts
statement: For a nonempty family of processes, pooling steps preserves exactly the union of finite endpoint histories iff that union is closed under joining. Retaining context realizes the union exactly; a joint context-changing relation derives successor support from the same incoming history.

title: Dependence that forms, holds, breaks and transforms
statement: Read as observables of the configuration, dependence makes every run a web in which each step keeps, breaks, forms or dissolves a dependence. Where activity needs support, theorems relate three outcomes of a loss, ending, transformation and restoration, and one process shows all three.

title: Finite horizon
statement: In the renewable process, and with feedback in the support-gated law, no finite prefix decides whether drawing renews or consumes.

title: Renewal on runs and the relational reading of living
statement: Renewal and consumption are classes of runs; under a correspondence discipline a common condition gives connection, and significance passes along co-participation.

title: Return grades
statement: Consumption is exactly a dependence that never returns, and recovery can slow without bound.

title: Existing interfaces are instances of the Becoming spine; comparison extends to every frame under the lifting rule
statement: Seed–edge closures (WholeGroundCoverage.Reached, CutCoverageAudit.Reach) and evaluator chains (EvaluatorGrounding.Chain) are exactly reachability on the edge process. A frame's reachable configurations form a joint-continuation space: a step- and claim-preserving map carries every jointly realizable bundle, and a summary whose steps lift and whose claims reflect loses none. A robust response is ex

title: The stepwise reading
statement: The stepwise reading classifies events within renewal and differs from the whole-run reading in both directions; it reads living as active and not undermining.

title: Binding-preserving substitution and its exact position criterion
statement: For the supplied finite typed-term language, substitution and context assignments, every consumer evaluates equally before and after replacement iff each replacement term supplies the ground at its original position. Constructed substitution retains positions under nested binders; single insertion and successive substitution satisfy the corresponding semantic equations.

title: Keeping pace under a bounded census
statement: Where the list returns within some number at arbitrarily late steps, coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace; under a bound growing without end, however slowly, arising can go on without ceasing.

title: Target uniqueness for branching tests
statement: If branching tests separate the target model, two target positions agreeing with one source position on all tests are equal.

title: Branching-test equivalence and bisimulation
statement: For two image-finite models, agreement on all finite branching tests is equivalent to a bisimulation relating the two positions.

title: The corpus's candidate theorems of the grammar, tested
statement: Of the first batch's 59 candidate theorems of the grammar, 38 hold for every carrier and relation, 15 hold only under a premise, 3 fail; the premises most often needed are double-negation stability and that nothing is its own condition.

title: Capture through the rule: a selection whose rule reads the share it selects
statement: Where a selection's rule is read monotonically from the share it selects, the loop locks: share and rule stop falling, a change of the rule's value that keeps its direction is absorbed at the next reading, and only a change of how the rule reads leaves. Without the start condition, it fails.

title: Standard causal models as processes
statement: x′ = F(x, u, ε) is a determined process whose move is the input and the noise. An intervention is a move not taken, unfixed by the record and fixed by the model; noise is a move not represented, and with it forgotten the process stays determined exactly where the noise makes no difference.

title: Ceasing needs arising
statement: Where what holds is listed at each step, ceasing to be recurring needs coming to be recurring; the converse fails.

title: The census balance under a continuation
statement: Under a continuation the census balance holds in two halves: without splits ceasing recurring needs arising recurring, and without merges under a bounded count conversely; with neither the balance is exact.

title: The census balance
statement: The list at the end with what ceased is the list at the start with what came; read of recurrence, it is exact.

title: The census read off the exchange
statement: Read off the exchange, the relata that exchange are listed with no decision procedure wherever a named family closes each step; every finite world has a census with its rest counted. No census fails at any step, and asking one at every step of every flow over Nat is LPO.

title: Censuses of the 象 and 彖 against the places
statement: The 小象 sentences saying a line is 中 are of middle places, those saying its way is exhausted of the top place, those of a broken line carrying an unbroken one of rises, the 彖's 中正 of middle lines in phase; the sentences listed apart are not of these places.

title: The central laws over every relation of exchange
statement: Each of the 33 central laws taking balance, only active giving or taking, or activity needing support holds over what is read off an exchange, those premises discharged by the reading; what stays a hypothesis is a state of the law or the law's own.

title: The Chinese sources on the spine
statement: 248 passages of nine parts of Chinese thought, quoted verbatim, are tied to the spine as agreement, exact scope or divergence. The relational start holds across the lines; their universal forms mostly need a scope; four non-relational overlays recur, each answered inside its tradition.

title: 《中华思想脉络》 on the spine, and the theory in classical names
statement: Every one of the 5,673 judgments of 《中华思想脉络》 v1.0 is read against the spine: 3,499 bear on its structures, each placed once, in 1,300 checked entries (453 agreements, 647 exact scopes, 200 divergences). 449 classical names, one per concept, state the theory in the 中华本《变化论》.

title: Claims shown in context
statement: What contexts show glues exactly where contexts agree where they meet, and a frame of context-free claims fits exactly where it glues everywhere; some worlds glue nowhere (Specker's boxes; the two-qubit Mermin–Peres square). Parts fail a whole in two ways: they do not give it back, or there is none.

title: Formation classes along a continuation: splits and merges
statement: Read along what continues it, renewing passes into every branch of a split and consuming back into every formation merged; these classes, tenure and undermining are fixed by the continuation under every renaming, are the named ones where each formation continues itself, and grow with links.

title: Classical definitions in the grammar
statement: Definitions of the frozen corpus written in the grammar hold for every carrier and relation: the 墨经's and 荀子's 化 are one form and are 成坏 along 缘, 同 is a class only where belonging is single, and continuation is neither identity nor mere difference.

title: Generative comparison and required organization under unsettled classification
statement: For fixed meanings and positive interpretation of fresh contents, the existing two-tier comparator strictly prefers A to B under every fresh classification exactly when A retains all fresh contents of B and is better with all fresh contents secondary. Equivalently, strict agreement at both extreme assignments covers every mixed assignment. This supplies required formation under each classification

title: Closed capture: a loop whose every level reads only the share
statement: In a selection whose rule, and how the rule is read, are read from the share it selects, a loss the loop does not read leaves it locked however large it grows, and a change of the reading is absorbed; what leaves is a change of the law, such as a reading of what lies beyond the share.

title: Closing needs a net draw
statement: A part closes what can form only by a net draw on a required condition, and opens it only by a net give. With it withheld, the rest unchanged, each level with what it took equals the unique level without it with what it gave; a formation is supported exactly while its net draw is within the margin.

title: Where the verdict within the closure meets the continuation condition
statement: Significance bounded by the whole is the continuation condition. Wherever every formation the other path admits lies in the region or is admitted by the first, the verdict bounded by the region is the condition's, so always where the feeding closure is the whole; in the clearer's web the two part.

title: Global support of coded joint plans
statement: After native lifting, a coded joint plan’s combined leaf requests are covered by the native whole without duplication under Within and Separate.

title: Coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace
statement: In a finite family whose counted determination is decided, coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace; this needs no premise about the unfolding.

title: Comparison C read as widening
statement: On level paths, an extension in which every claim counts as living is exactly a widening of what can form, by unfolding Extension there into Widens; with “better” read as widening, C holds for every reading of living, with no axiom; that widening is better is an open warrant.

title: Relational fidelity of comparison content: minimum requirements, grouping and real loss
statement: On one Frame with its process unchanged, claims are regrouped many-to-one. Recovering each original realization is exactly constancy within each group at that configuration; fidelity at both configurations preserves the existing Extension comparison. title: Comparison where the rest responds
statement: Where every formation outside a part responds through its couplings, two flows compare within its responsive reach: beyond it they are alike through the couplings, the part exchanges alike, and the difference never arrives; where only support couples in, the reach is the union of reach closures.

title: Comparison within reach
statement: The comparison is decided within what the part reaches: any significance covering what the part has reached before each step compares the levels with and without it as the continuation condition does, and the comparison of any two flows is decided within what their difference reaches.

title: A correspondence discipline for conditions
statement: Interaction alone relates through a condition; idle conditions no longer connect for free, and connection is made by living use.

title: Five-condition acceptance of the conditional foundation
statement: The existing review assesses the candidate as meeting its original five completion conditions under explicit local laws and normative premises.

title: Conditions kept together, and keeping a part
statement: Under every course, guards decompose exactly; along some course they do not, and no rule on the separate keepabilities decides the joint one. No course leaving a part's guard decides neither renewal nor what the run does to others.

title: A configuration is how it relates
statement: Configurations related by a bisimulation are alike and pass the same tests; a description makes sense where it identifies exactly the alike ones, and carries a law where the frame is determined up to likeness; determinacy as equality depends on names.

title: A confined rise within a whole, and what a founding carries
statement: A lineage confined to a whole's conditions in excess has no member once they end, whatever selection within raised; selection within a whole founded uniform needs variation arisen in it; where next founders carry their founder's value, selection among wholes decides the rise.

title: Acquired consequences revise reference construction and actual use
statement: The general laws of contacts and stock (Becoming.Contacts, Becoming.Stock) carry the connection from consequence to later use. title: Constitutive binding and the limits of presuppositionless promotion
statement: A fresh reference can be instituted by its introduction; actual retention and insertion under unchanged content and assessment explain local support transmission without a fresh endorsement proposition at each use.

title: Consumption ends with its feeders
statement: Under balance, with only active formations giving and activity needing support, a formation taking from a condition fed by nothing supported, as where feeders are unsupported, stays active at most as many consecutive steps as that level; keeping its own support, it can still end through its feeder.

title: Public-data correspondence for context-sensitive updating
statement: Reanalysis of 24 participants supports an increased perturbation contrast across training and a post-training cue effect; an acquired increase in the cue effect is uncertain and its later finite-window effect is weaker.

title: Decomposition of the continuation condition
statement: Where the whole is admissible, the continuation condition is exactly the presupposition sub-true and boundary-invariant at every standpoint. Invariance is the conditional from presupposition to condition, carrying all it adds; with presupposition and covering everywhere, it is standpoint neutrality.

title: The continuation condition yields living significance
statement: The continuation condition yields living significance, self-significance at every standpoint, both neutralities and a seed on every reading where a claim's significance is a formation's continuation, C on level paths, and discharges every use of living significance.

title: Continuation relative to a class
statement: For every carrier and relation, continuation is 缘 met with a class; its positions depend on the class, a class constant under 缘 never lets a continuation end, a line's own regularity is the class's core, and the old base's arising, ceasing, lineage and passing are its instances.

title: Openness and the rest theorem
statement: Enclosure excludes endless change: over enclosed steps any change of standing lowers the total, so an enclosed, balanced, dissipative world with finite censuses and embodied arising cannot be refuted to come to rest, its exchange not recurring; the premises decide neither enclosure nor openness.

title: A continuing family cannot go unfed from beyond
statement: A continuing family cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it, the conveyance form of the draw-in laws. With equality decided, being fed from beyond is exactly a step that is not inward; being fed is needed, and no source condition need recur.

title: Time scales as a tower of discrete readings
statement: Each level reads the next finer one at strictly increasing times, and balance (each relatum listed once) and dissipation pass to coarser levels. At any level, with what stands not refuted to run down at each fine step, a coarsest stretch has no more falls of total standing than its starting total.

title: Control-response loss and recovery through retained joint relations
statement: For every reduction and observable: what the observable reads through the reduction is single-valued exactly where it agrees across what the reduction merges; on two configurations the reduction merges, a decoder right at both exists exactly when the observable agrees there, so no map restores two different configurations it merges. In the specified real-amplitude fragment, controlled X/Z order an

title: Conveyance crosses the boundary
statement: Read with one kind of relatum, conveyance is a candidate reading of related. A continuing family's boundary is from no step on left uncrossed, so its region is no cut in the relations; conveyance relates two conditions, which interaction, living on and descent never do.

title: Copied witnesses change nothing
statement: Where each witness added to a roster copies one already on it, in its reports, its support and every fault set it is inside, inspection takes the same steps and gives the same certificate; the roster listed twice is the case.

title: Copying b-fold
statement: Where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes b, n rounds from k units run exactly where the stock covers d times what they draw for, ending with k times b to the n units; doubling is the case b = 2.

title: The counterfactual is the course
statement: Where the rest follows one law of exchange reading what has stood, the counterfactual of an act is the course that law generates: fixed by the act, balanced exactly where feasible, and compared within the responsive reach with neither the second flow nor the response supplied.

title: Counting what stands and what depends
statement: Under each selection of the premises, what stands obeys the laws of counting what is active; under enclosure, balance and dissipation alone bound the change of what stands, with no embodiment; and the premises add no law to counting dependences.

title: Enclosure bounds change
statement: Enclosure bounds change: from the step it holds, the relata active together with the steps of change stay within the total standing then. Finite and enclosed worlds have the same laws of counting under a selection exactly when it bounds change and binds counting; binding adds at most three more.

title: The laws of counting where the counts exist
statement: Every law of counting of Becoming.Counting that takes decided activity holds of every counted census, the counts taken as relations, for every property of the counts and with decision asked only where a count exists; the one law left is a statement of logical strength.

title: Counting is a relation
statement: A count exists exactly where what it counts is decided, and a decision procedure's marks are the count; the census between counts needs no decidedness.

title: Coupled regimes: a margin that is not its own
statement: Two conditions under draws, each giving from what is left of both: under mutual support the order of states is kept and ending is down-closed; within a band in whole numbers runs rest and a condition's point of no return falls as its partner rises; a dependent ends after its partner.

title: Coupled webs: support across a web, and the cascade of ends
statement: Any number of conditions each giving from what is left of all: under mutual support raising any level never ends one that held; along every chain of total dependence, with positive draws, the end of one ends everything downstream, a dependence cycle ending together.

title: The coupling closures of deployed training pipelines
statement: In each published way of selecting a deployed model's behaviour the signal is a function of what its deciders read, so the selection laws' premise holds by construction; three published measurements find optimizing through that coupling lowering what the deciders do not read.

title: A dependence formed from drawing
statement: Where depending and drawing part at the giver, under the reading of drawing a dependence forms anew at a descent exactly where the giver drew on what it did not depend on: a dependence formed by descent is a giver's drawing become its descendant's dependence.

title: Premise-tracked derivation soundness
statement: If Derives basis context p, every interpretation satisfying the entire basis and local context satisfies p.

title: Limits of the derived extent
statement: The derived extent runs one way, to what one's continuation depends on, and ends with the want; a continuing formation meeting every requirement derived here can still end a life it does not need. Along dependence the center is not derived from the dynamics.

title: Exactness of a local law derived from history summaries
statement: For a prefix-closed language L and summary q, the local law constructed from admitted one-step extensions preserves all finite continuations at every admitted history exactly iff histories sharing a code have identical continuation profiles.

title: Determinacy up to likeness
statement: Determinacy is the named case of determinacy up to likeness, and the laws on how configurations relate hold up to likeness, including when a description carries a law; an intervention on one of alike configurations, a past no claim tells apart and a description no claim tells apart need equality.

title: Differences below the threshold
statement: Where the exchange follows a formation's couplings, a difference in a stock coupled into it by threshold only stays until the two webs' support diverges; coupling the stock in by level lifts it, and others responding to the stock itself break it.

title: Division by exclusive footprints
statement: Where what formations take from a condition is what the leaves of a realized joint plan draw, the parts' footprints within their whole's and apart and the root's within what is given, the joint draw is within what is given; under balance, so at every step, the level never falls.

title: Dormancy over a stretch, and final ending
statement: Bounded dormancy needs its premises only over the stretch; an ending that is final stays whatever support returns, so a return later than the reserve finds none, while a reserve spanning the gap bridges it.

title: Drawers in turn draw everything
statement: With two drawers in turn, each ranking what it draws over the steps that remain, every profile at a mutual best response at every step from every level draws everything: the base stands from the first step at what stands at nothing.

title: Drawers in turn within capacities
statement: Drawers in turn whose capacity limits a draw draw to capacity at the last step and wherever the other's later draw is fixed, and unlimited are SG14's perfect profiles; a limit on the other's draw can make restraint the best response and keep the base.

title: Drawers in turn
statement: Drawers in turn are one model, each with a floor, on one law of best response: what a drawer keeps above its floor returns to it at least one for one; so where two drawers have no floor, revision and perfection both come to the floors, whatever the others' floors.

title: Draws on one shared stock: every combination fits exactly when the total does
statement: Of the first n draws, given as natural numbers, every selection fits within the stock exactly when their total does.

title: Drift: offspring sampled rather than listed
statement: A next generation sampled from listed offspring keeps the listed share on average with an exact spread; the samplings undoing a step's selection, ending among groups included, weigh at most a share falling as 1/n and at least q^n.

title: Preparation bounds and actual changes in joint realization
statement: Under a fixed relational law and realization interpretation, joint realization within n steps after an actual prefix is reachable through the same intermediate configuration within prefix length plus n steps. title: Endpoint opportunity loss and return
statement: Along an actual finite trace under a fixed relational law, all existential endpoint possibilities are preserved exactly when a return path exists. Failure to return has a constructive lost endpoint witness; incomplete questions can hide this loss.

title: Entropy, history and record
statement: Premise-free, the history of exchanges is monotone; lossless exchange can continue and return; under balance and the first law an arrow leaves a finite family no change at arbitrarily late steps; and recording each exchange within the conserved amount decomposes the least loss exactly.

title: Every loss passes a juncture
statement: Where s returns, every course to a configuration that cannot have s again passes, not not, a juncture: one step there keeps s to be had and one loses it. Finding it is deciding reach (LPO for every process). Keeping the steps that keep s keeps s, the largest that does on its course from s.

title: Every origin passes the gate
statement: For any process and decided gate: if ungated steps reflect a property, a course ending where it holds starts there or passes a gated step after which it does, the property undecided; leaving a preserved one passes it. Asked of every process, propositional gates make this double-negation elimination.

title: Evolution on descent
statement: Evolution on descent rests on a premise-free arithmetic identity; only supported formations leave descendants, what is transmitted within a bound was selected within it, and activity sets later selection.

title: Independent exchanges commute

title: Every optimum rebuilds a depleted base
statement: Below a level out of one step's reach, where the next level and the weighted gain rise with the level, every optimum of a far-sighted order rebuilds the base as fast as it renews, drawing nothing, and restores every dependence whose need the rising level meets.

title: The order of exchanges as the invariant
statement: With a footprint containing the exchanges, commuting unjoined exchanges keeps the partial order of joined ones up to renumbering and reaches every order-keeping renumbering. A world with the same exchanges, footprints and changes so ordered, from one start, agrees with a reordering at every step.

title: Exchanges sharing a relatum need not commute
statement: Two exchanges sharing their relatum, taken in two orders from one configuration, can reach different configurations: the condition of act_comm cannot be dropped.

title: The orders of a carried difference as a sum over histories
statement: The carried amount is a sum over routes back in time: at horizon j + 1 the sum over histories is order j, a cut being a truncation; every such sum expands by order, exact to its horizon; with every condition listed and the law stationary, a finite horizon is exact exactly where no loop is upstream.

title: Required organization under whole generative comparison
statement: In a finite nonempty eligible range, if every continuation lacking an organizational relation has a strictly better eligible construction, every undefeated choice includes that relation. This can warrant building or strengthening shared capacity without fixing one carrier.

title: Formation and inheritance of organizational rule differences
statement: For every process, gate on moves and quantity of configurations: the quantity is kept along every course of ungated moves exactly when every ungated step keeps it; a course that changes it passes the gate, at a gated step that itself changes it. title: Others drawing first end the base
statement: The far-sighted weighted optimum laws hold over any law of what stands; where others first draw from what an optimizer leaves at least what the remainder renews, every optimum of an order whose weighting falls at every step ends the base at once.

title: Counting one's own draw misses joint excess
statement: Formations each taking within what is given can together exceed it; with natural-number amounts, joint excess cannot outlast what was held. Where renewers depend on what they renew, it ends the renewal and those depending at such a need, a taker among them where it so depends.

title: From a standpoint's own good to reachable living significance
statement: A standpoint's own good (self-significance), with unrestricted monotonicity and tolerance, gives a standpoint-indexed instance of living significance on reachable generation.

title: Own widening within the margin
statement: Where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margins of what the others need, and is mixed exactly beyond; with no slack, any net draw on a needed condition makes it mixed.

title: Pending-task applicability and supported continuation
statement: For every stock, a course of draws is executable exactly when each draw is within the stock then standing. Review draws one unit of work and action two, so the review-and-action course is covered exactly from three current units, and an endpoint completes its review and action exactly when the report clears the relevant risk and its work covers that course; refusal or exhaustion retains the unfini

title: The relations of the places, read in context
statement: The relations of a hexagram's places, 正, 應, 比 and 中, are readings in context: they glue to a reading of the whole only where every site agrees, the trigrams exactly where no height is opposed. Along every run, opposition is told by phase; the oppositions carry waxing and waning, the phases do not.

title: Place/transition nets on the spine
statement: Place/transition nets, defined by their own rules, are an instance of the spine: the flow balances the markings exactly on firing sequences, and dissipation is exactly a strict P-subinvariant on what fires; so rising with falling, bounded taking, rest and the siphon law hold of such nets.

title: Positive reasons addressed to every situated position
statement: Under explicit living significance, formation correspondence E and a positioned direct articulation D, every position with actual access to a response has a contributory reason for it, whatever its endorsement, substrate or identity labels. The least reason satisfying D is fixed by access and positive ground alone, so positions alike in access are alike in this reason; a position without access re

title: Certain positive ground with open forms in visible futures
statement: Under explicit living significance and generative correspondence, one response realizing some new generation in every presently grounded continuation has some positive ground in each continuation, without fixing one new form across all of them. Explicit direct practical articulation supplies a contributory reason. The finite construction retains old joint possibilities, distinct real future branch

title: Practical judgment under living significance and the practical commitments
statement: Living significance with the explicit practical commitments and actual correspondence supplies a general candidate for preservation, transformation, actual transfer, finite ending and bounded responsibility.

title: All prefix questions can still omit an intermediate loss
statement: Two reached positions in one connected process agree on every finite branch question over complete blocks and all their nonempty prefixes, yet differ in intermediate loss. No formula in the whole prefix language translates that loss question. Exposing the suffix at the reached position restores the distinction, which every native exact account must preserve.

title: Premises read off the exchange
statement: Read off the exchange with the rest of the whole counted as a relatum, every world balances and only active relata give and take; under a law of exchange, with requirement read as response, activity needs support. Balance is then the rest idle, and no course fixes requirement.

title: Dissipation, embodiment and transmission are states of the law
statement: Read off laws of exchange, with the rest counted and idle and the four tying premises holding, dissipation, embodiment and bounded transmission are each met by one world and failed by another. With the rest counted, embodiment is balance and each relatum exchanging exactly while it stands.

title: Two scopes of the self's presupposition
statement: Along a relation the presupposition sub-true is significance over the closure, and super-true is the continuation condition; route (b) and the continuation condition are one presupposition with “however the boundary is drawn” at narrow and at wide scope.

title: Process and frame as readings of one unfolding
statement: The move is read within the configuration, a world's moves being its relata's exchanges; a history is a run of the law it shows, the correspondence not an identity, the gap being memory; a claim is a relatum.

title: A projection carrying a law
statement: A projection carries a determined law exactly where configurations alike under it go alike; what the step does not depend on is re-absorbed in one step; a system changing its own rule has its law on the joint configuration.

title: What identifying interderivable propositions keeps and loses (propext)
statement: propext holds exactly where every reading of propositions is lumped by interderivability, and exactly where the reading by name is; readings built from relations need no axiom. The identification forgets no witness and keeps every outcome; what it stops is the course.

title: Basic-condition priority
statement: Basic-condition priority is independent of C, excludes every natural-number score, and is representable by a bounded score.

title: Raising what couples in draws from beyond
statement: Where a family containing what couples in gains nothing across a step, a rise of what couples in has a formation that gives it more than it takes from it and takes from beyond it; so every selection holding only where what couples in rises holds only on flows reaching beyond the coupling.

title: What comparison principle C ranks under each reading
statement: For every family of courses, a law says exactly when a renewing course extends another under either living reading. Stepwise C keeps sharing above winning by consumption and restraint above overdraw, not the absence of an overdrawer included before the loss; the possibility reading keeps all three.

title: Re-optimizing above a renewal ends it
statement: Over a course in which a part re-optimizes at every step, a dependence on a condition beyond, renewed by r at its need and at most r below, is lost exactly where the draw exceeds r, for good; the renewal below the need decides only the drawers' take; several optimizers jointly above r lose it.

title: Reaching before and after a juncture
statement: With every configuration listed and steps decided, what can be had again is had within as many steps as there are configurations; at a configuration that is not a juncture, no step can be refuted to keep it.

title: Reading another's couplings is pooling with it
statement: A formation coupled by level into everything another couples into selects through at least their pooled coupling, and its coupling closure is the union of the two closures where the other exchanges with what it couples into; beyond that union it is blind.

title: Reading through a pool
statement: Where the rule reads the fast configuration only through what a pool reads of it, two courses with one rule at a reading step, read alike by the pool there, have one rule after it: rules part at a reading step only where the pool's reading parts.

title: A family of readings within what it reads
statement: A family of readings indexed by what it reads is complete exactly where nothing differs; completing it is an unfolding that never closes, never returns and is held by no finite stock; the liar is a rhythm with no still value.

title: Evidence recovery and the limits of stop access after interrupted change
statement: For every partial law and admission, a property holds after every admitted course from every start where it holds exactly when every admitted step keeps it; and counted work finishes in work + 1 ticks exactly when the fuel covers them, no shorter run finishing. The recoverable device is an instance of both. Its histories, interruptions included, are the courses of its admitted steps, so a durable

title: Recurrence without decidedness
statement: In a finite family, recurring coming to be refutes any end to ceasing, and conversely; decided where it is sought, the step is found, and decided from some step on, the two recur together.

title: Recurrence under every law of change
statement: For every law of change within finitely many configurations, merging nothing is returning is keeping every possibility, and a rise needs a merge; becoming that keeps its history loses nothing, never returns and needs openness, and a finite present forgets; no premise is used.

title: Prepared material joins recurrent chain formation
statement: For every alphabet and law of draws, a copy of a word produces the word exactly when the pool supplies it and the support covers what it draws; where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes two, n rounds from k units run exactly when the stock covers d·k(2^n−1), ending with k·2^n units.
