title: Activity forms reference revision and makes it recur
statement: The general laws of stock (Becoming.Stock) govern continuing revision: along every run of a balanced process, drawing at arbitrarily late steps needs replenishment at arbitrarily late steps, and unending repetition of a cycle needs its return to cover its draw. ContinuingRevision is an instance, extending ReferencePlan’s operations. Its fuel is balanced against what each act uses and what renewal

title: The regime in any amounts, and its runs over the reals
statement: The regime's order, the shape of its runs and its rests hold in any linearly ordered amounts with a draw; over the reals every run of a rising adjustment within a band converges, to a rest where the adjustment is continuous, and need not come to rest.

title: The regime's point under giving that adjusts
statement: Where giving adjusts, reading what is left and the recent giving, every rest of the state at or above the draw is the regime's if the adjustment rests at the draw where the regime gives it; the point decides the fate where recent giving lies on the level's side.

title: Regulation from one side, beyond the gap, and locally
statement: With balance, a level below m with no exchange raising it there never returns to m; overcorrecting never rests at m; formations each opposing on their own condition regulate it, and a family so regulated settles in total with nothing reading the total.

title: Relata counted through relations
statement: The number of relata each list of each world holds, read up to indiscernibility, is fixed exactly under excluded middle; counting by name gives one decided identity more; read by occurrence, every flow lists what takes part once with its amounts unchanged.

title: The relation-level reading's law of easing, and restraint under it
statement: Read relation by relation, easing withdraws exactly the relations the easing course no longer takes part in or undermines; restraint that lets no level fall and keeps taking part ranks above overdraw for any number of drawers under the relation-level reading too.

title: Relational information required for a joint-generative comparison
statement: Under one event law, retaining and releasing a coupling have identical marginal possibilities, while retention preserves every represented joint bundle and adds the full bundle. Feeding this structural output into explicit comparison principle C excludes any irreflexive comparator over a summary fully determined by those marginals. A joint-bundle description distinguishes the case; richer possibil

title: Read relationally, comparison ranks consuming formation below its absence
statement: Read relationally, the course from which an overdrawing formation is absent renews every condition and extends the course with it, an instance of a law of comparison for every family of courses, so comparison principle C ranks it strictly higher; read event by event, C does not decide.

title: Renewing and consuming as a relation to participated conditions
statement: Renewing and consuming are relations of a formation to the conditions it depends on or draws on: loss of renewal for good is a law of every balanced flow, the support-gated family's overdraw and joint drawing end renewal as its instances, and no formation's own trajectory decides its class.

title: Relative position is zero-sum; a race ends those ahead only through their dependence
statement: A part's position against the others is zero-sum by counting: its rise is the rest's summed fall, whatever the amounts do. A race of joint excess ends a part through its dependence on the condition, not its position; where those ahead do not so depend, they can continue.

title: Renewing and consuming formation: a dynamical distinction in one wear-law class
statement: Under an explicit no-recovery wear law, formation within the renewal rate continues at every step and keeps its renewal capacity. Formation whose pressure persistently exceeds the current renewal rate has a whole-unfolding total bounded by held conditions plus a triangular renewal bound, ceases from that time, and permanently loses capacity from its first excess. Formation sharing those conditions

title: Repeated disturbance
statement: With the part giving gaps at most E at the steps a schedule marks, the carried amount is at most (D + E d) times (1 + M) to the a, d the disturbed steps and a the coupling steps; each disturbance adds what the later couplings multiply.

title: A represented boundary and actual dependence
statement: Renewal over a region of conditions is renewal at the step where the region covers what the formation takes part in. Covering what it requires, with requirements not tightening, it keeps its own support yet can undermine another; omitting what it requires, its own draw can lose its own support.

title: Necessary response is the weakest sound reading of requirement
statement: Over every relation of exchange, necessary response is the weakest reading of requirement that does not read the current level of what is required and under which activity needs support on every run; possible response is not sound.

title: Requirement as response where several exchanges are open
statement: Where a relation of exchange leaves several exchanges open, requirement read as necessary response gives activity needing support on every run, and with the rest counted the four tying premises hold; read as possible response it does not. A law is the relation leaving one exchange open.

title: A reserve defers the end
statement: A reserve defers the end, which still comes: Dependent, activity only where supported, is the zero reserve; a reserve can be a held condition; and a decaying reserve bounds coextinction link by link along a chain of any length.

title: Reserved shutdown during incomplete recovery
statement: For every partial law with a reserved exit, where every admitted move from a valid configuration goes on, stays valid, and either takes the exit or lowers a margin by one, and the exit is kept: every admitted course from a valid configuration runs and stays valid, and every admitted course longer than the margin ends at the exit; the bound is attained. The recovery supervisor with a protected curr

title: Partial unfolding with residuals and resumption at reached positions
statement: Joint unfolding of residual programs and reached conditions has exact completion/resumption correspondence and native trace projection. Common syntax, complete native-answer agreement and receiving-side finite branching recover residuals and answers along every partial history. Inserted activity and a current-position suffix join into one trace, but insertion can disable a pending continuation; re

title: Rest at every resolution
statement: The natural-number unit is a quantum of loss. Without counting the refinement, loss in proportion sets the least bound on what an enclosed family exchanges and, with a least size, bounds the times of exchange, growth, fall, arising and ceasing; a least fall of the reserve bounds the end it defers.

title: Rest by balance
statement: A count balanced across each step that loses at least one more than it gains at each falls by at least the number of steps; so marked steps cannot outrun what stood, and two balanced counts compare by their exchanges alone.

title: Rest exactly where the total stops falling
statement: Over any amounts, a balanced, dissipated family stops changing exactly where its total stops falling, and a world rests where its census total does. A least fall in Archimedean amounts or a finite reading gives this; along an amount falling at every step a world never rests.

title: Rest from a finite reading
statement: Read off configurations a list holds, an amount that does not rise falls strictly at most as often as the list is long, over any amounts: no least loss, Archimedean property, totality or decision. Falls that recur need a reading no list holds.

title: Rest and points of no return on coupled webs
statement: For finitely many coupled conditions within a band under mutual support, a run comes to rest, and each condition's point of no return, given the others, is exact and does not rise as any other level rises.

title: The rest theorem in any amounts, read finitely
statement: Read a world's standings and exchanges in any amounts. Balanced and dissipated on, a family's total falls strictly at every change of a level, with no least loss; where the census's total is read off configurations a list holds, the rest theorem holds there.

title: Refinement counted as a giving
statement: Counted as a formation that only gives, the splitting of the unit is excluded by dissipation and enclosure wherever anything stands, so rest follows from the fixed-unit theorem, unrefutable as there; arising without end needs openness, and the witnesses that leave it uncounted are fed by it.

title: Restoring giving from the worst start
statement: For every law of giving that keeps inclusion, giving at step n from every start is giving at n from total withholding, from which giving only grows. Where a formation gives first, restoring by n is exactly no chain of n waits clear of sources.

title: Cross-articulation formation matching with retained references
statement: Finite configurations over different fragment carriers with equal initial slot counts and agreement on all retained-reference branch questions match every finite formation command sequence under finite fixed-pair outcomes, preserving the original configuration, final answers and slot alignment. Exact accounts of the same actual process must distinguish its idle and spent histories.

title: Later source learning binds retained records
statement: Records read through a family of explanations: for every type of records, meanings and worlds, where each bearing record is explained by some family world with the target, a form resolves to the target exactly when every other meaning of a repertoire without repeats is ruled out by some bearing record that no family world with that meaning explains. For earlier naming records reread through acquir

title: Revisiting, novelty and forgetting on the levels alone
statement: On the levels alone, a part with bounded stock revisits a configuration from every step on; a part new at every step exceeds every bound; a bounded part exchanged with without end, and a finite whole, do not carry their history; with loss at each change, change does not recur without end.

title: Returning where the course branches
statement: What returns can be had at every step; every configuration returns exactly where each region the process stays in keeps all its possibilities. Keeping every possibility does not give returning; merging nothing gives it along runs in finitely many configurations, and a merge may lose no possibility.

title: Revision comes to drawing everything
statement: Drawers in turn revising toward best responses, from any profile, both leave nothing at every step from round 2N on: they come to the perfect profile within twice the horizon, mutual restraint included.

title: Revision with an undecided value
statement: With an undecided value below true and false, revision of N sentences speaking only of one another, run from all undecided, settles within N steps, exactly, at the least fixed point. Where two-valued revision has no fixed point, every fixed point leaves a sentence undecided.

title: Rising and falling in one exchange
statement: In a balanced flow, across a step at which a family is dissipated on, a member rising comes with another member of the family falling.

title: Risk bounds and realized outcomes
statement: In the supplied three-route process with two finite equal-weight event laws, a true one-third risk bound permits actual failure; no judge using only the mode/arrival projection correctly classifies that prior bound for every admitted realization of both laws.

title: Rivals bounded in time
statement: A rule holding exactly within a region accepts the continuation condition's rule there and is not it where something lies outside; a rule bounded in time is such a rival, and in the clearer's witness it permits what the condition counts as a loss.

title: Room read off the exchange
statement: Over one step of exchange, where a part's members take at most their capacity and give at most what they take, room holds; every optimum of every order rising with what couples in stands beyond at what the rest leaves less the part's capacity, lowering a condition just where the part has capacity.

title: Runaway, and the distance to the break that does not couple in
statement: Every policy through the couplings, with the rest of the exchange fixed, that keeps its support leaves unused any larger stock coupled into it by threshold only; for such a stock, how far off the break is does not couple in before the break.

title: Families chosen step by step
statement: Only a condition holding what stands before and after joins one step to the next, and continuity up to order replaces following position by position.

title: Necessary relational foundation of scientific inquiry
statement: Target: test whether the full proposed core is indispensable across the stated scientific scope, assessing from independent achievements and actual relationships within one unfolding which commitments are necessary and which condition particular descriptions.

title: Where seeking rests: more than now never does, above all others never for two
statement: Under a determined law, seeking rests exactly at a state the law leaves unchanged that meets its target: more than now needs an open world, and above all others never holds of two; where what stands is listed, rising without end needs steps that do not run down, and running down stops it.

title: Selection among groups by ending
statement: Where groups with less of an amount leave no offspring, nothing is selected against it among groups; on the base, a group whose own condition ran into joint excess leaves none. One condition shared by every group ends every group, so it supplies no selection among them.

title: Selection right exactly where what matters is read
statement: What matters goes alike across a map's lumping exactly where it is read off the map, so some selection through the map selects exactly what matters exactly where the map reads it.

title: The selection term proper, over generations
statement: Price's selection term proper is concordance less discordance of offspring number and amount, denominators cleared; over generations a mean moves only through selection proper or transmission, and where activity needs support a reading highest at the supported is never selected against.

title: Selection through a map of the alternatives
statement: For alternatives with decided equality and a map giving each an entry of any kind: two are selected alike by every selection through the map exactly when the map ties them, and such a selection selecting at most one alternative can select k exactly when no other alternative's entry equals k's.

title: Selection through the couplings
statement: Every selection through a selector's couplings selects histories alike exactly when they are alike through them. With the rest fixed, selection is blind beyond the coupling closure; pooled couplings select an ending beyond it within reach, and a flow raising what couples in from beyond is selected.

title: Which selections survive and remain executable when the lumping changes
statement: On the existing Process/Trace/Run, relations at configurations describe indistinguishability. Where the old relation is an equivalence, every selection through the old lumping is expressible through the new lumping iff new indistinguishability implies old indistinguishability; a merged old pair supplies a lost choice. Preservation composes through actual intermediate configurations, with a direct

title: Selection with returns to groupmates
statement: Where each unit kept gives b to every member of the keeper's group and takes c from the keeper, the whole selects for keeping exactly where b + c times the spread falls short of m b times the spread among groups: Hamilton's rule, with the assortment that share.

title: Selection within and among groups of any sizes
statement: For groups of any sizes the selection term divides into the groups' own terms and the term of their means; groups alike in mean leave selection within alone, so the next generation's listing fixes the next step's among-group part, which ending can use up.

title: Selection within groups and among them
statement: For a family listed as groups of equal size, the selection term proper divides exactly into selection within the groups and selection among them; an amount selected against within every group is selected for in the whole only where selection among groups goes for it.

title: Self-concern through dependence
statement: Held de se, self-concern is the same from every standpoint exactly where the centers lie within one another's closures, as centers sharing one condition do; drawn along need, it reaches a copy of what it needs exactly where that copy is the only one.

title: The least coupling with any number of conditions
statement: A law reading finitely many conditions under each history reads through what it is sensitive to: up to double negation, sensitivity is the least coupling. Given a decision of vanishing (giving LPO) the tail law is a counterexample; with numbered conditions every counterexample gives WLPO.

title: Separation loses exactly the relation
statement: Describing the parts separately gives back the whole exactly where it is rectangular; a relation forms only by joint action, lasts under separate laws that lose nothing, and ends only by loss or joint action; parity is a whole its pairs do not give back.

title: Several optimizers drain by their joint capacity
statement: At a mutual best response of several optimizers, each optimizing alone by its own order, a condition beyond every one's family falls by their joint capacity, as under one optimizer of that capacity; each takes its whole capacity wherever something stands.

title: Significance retained within the margin
statement: Retaining and adding significance are a preorder and an excess on admission; under the continuation condition, inclusion and exceeding from every standpoint. A part loses a significant continuation exactly where its net draw exceeds the margin, and adds one exactly where its net exchange admits it.

title: Public-data correspondence for situated recovery
statement: Public records from 16 participants support finite mean response retention and constrain the predictive scope of simple temporal curves; greater model complexity is not uniformly superior.

title: Slowing down before a condition's own end
statement: Where a condition is observed, the margin to its own end couples into its fluctuations: the stationary variance Var E/(1 − a²) and lag-1 autocorrelation a rise as the return multiplier a rises to one before a fold or transcritical end, and give back the margin; a dependent's need enters neither.

title: The whole and its parts
statement: Premise-free laws hold of every world and premises carve parts: in a finite world whose activity is decided arising recurs exactly when ceasing does, living crosses arising and ceasing, and under dissipation a finite world cannot be refuted to come to rest.

title: Steps met again after a fall
statement: Counted at every step met, wherever, a coupling a step keeps a need under every optimum exactly where r + e < q + c + m and e < c, strictly above the count from the start: a fall met again loses the coupling only at the steps below.

title: The stepwise law of easing, and restraint over any number of drawers under the stepwise reading
statement: Under easing the stepwise reading withdraws exactly the events the easing course undermines; a course whose levels never fall undermines nothing, so restraint that takes within what it gives ranks above overdraw for any number of drawers under the stepwise reading too.

title: Substitution preserves consumption on the whole-run reading
statement: On the whole-run reading a consumer that persists by transforming its dependence still consumes under every such transformation exactly where the loss falls on a dependence other than the transformed one; a law of every web, with the support-gated law with a substitutable condition as an instance.

title: The exact sum over histories
statement: For every weighting, the weighted sum over courses of n steps is n steps of the transfer; possibility is the core's relation, counting refines it without loss, and integrating out is exact exactly where it is lumpable at one step.

title: Sums over histories by support, horizon and exact order
statement: A weighting that vanishes off a possibility sums only where the possibility reaches; the transfer splits at every horizon; where alternatives commute, exact order i sums the courses with exactly i responses, Routes’ orders being its partial sums; what is carried depends only on the steps between.

title: Support from the supported
statement: Support is gained only from the supported: under balance, with only active formations giving and activity needing support, every rise is given by a supported formation. Crossing a threshold needs a change in a required condition or in a requirement; with nothing given from beyond, the end absorbs.

title: Support passed on by later gainers
statement: In a balanced flow where only active formations give, activity needs support, requirements never loosen and support spells are bounded, support gained ever later cannot be refuted to come from givers that themselves gained support after any given step.

title: Supported repair and reformation of a sustaining relation
statement: Restoration is a law of every balanced flow: joint net giving over enough steps raises a condition's level to any target. In the support-gated law a supported contribution route restores the sustaining activity as an instance, while two actual histories with the same later inputs recover or do not.

title: Synonyms and coined forms
statement: A code letting a sense hold several forms reads every held form back as its sense exactly where no two senses hold one form; a form coined at a sense and heard by all brings back a distinction an imposed code merged.

title: Taking what most hold
statement: Each formation taking, at each sense, a form more than half the formations hold, where there is one, makes no form; two of three agree at once and one of two rests, so agreement under it still needs a break of symmetry.

title: The capture of a target, and why perturbing the state alone is re-absorbed
statement: Where each target carrier leaves more offspring than each other parent, both present, their share is larger among offspring than parents; where what stands is listed and runs down from some step on, descent stops; where the next step depends on the rule alone, a perturbed state is re-absorbed.

title: Testing within the couplings
statement: A claim is excluded only through a difference in what couples in, and exclusion relative to a model excludes the model and the claim together. Where members respond only through their own couplings, nothing beyond the coupling closure shows within it; testing is relational.

title: Testing within the net
statement: What a finite stage of approximation tells apart is not in the core of a class, and a wider net tells apart what a narrower one does not, with no intervener outside the net.

title: Tests that fix likeness
statement: Linear tests fix likeness where both frames are determined up to likeness, and branching tests fix it where both frames are finite with decided steps and claims, by a constructive proof. Linear tests see exactly likeness with every branching postponed.

title: The boundary of enough under undetermined laws
statement: Under an undetermined law enough parts in two: some run can come to rest with its target met exactly where a reachable configuration stays and meets it; every run must exactly where every such configuration meets it and every run settles; under a determined law the two are one.

title: The breeding value
statement: An amount combining carried amounts that reproduces offspring number's covariation with each has its covariation with offspring number equal to its own spread, at most the whole; with exact transmission its mean rises by that spread: Fisher's fundamental theorem with breeding values.

title: The gap for one's own act
statement: Where the rest follows a law of exchange reading through coupling, an act whose difference stays beyond the actor's coupling closure is selected alike, with and without it, by every selection through any member of the closure; with both acts laws nothing is supplied.

title: The last change of a run
statement: In a world a list holds, settling wherever no reachable change can be undone is exactly LPO; a run a list of N holds with no change within a loop changes fewer than N times and, with decidable configurations, is not not settled and settles exactly where each step decides whether it changes again.

title: The move alone does not fix the outcome
statement: Where a step by a move has situations reaching two different configurations, the finer law takes both by the same move, and no law giving the next configuration from the configuration and the move alone is right on both.

title: The rest outruns the renewal
statement: Where the other members alone take more than a gated renewal gives, the condition ends whatever a member takes, and with need one every reading of it after the end is alike under the member's acts: no weight of such a reading selects its restraint.

title: The run classes and widening
statement: Where only active formations take, a part drawing only on conditions renewed over the run does not narrow, and a consumed dependence met without a part makes a part opening nothing narrow; a part that never arises changes nothing. No class decides alone.

title: The split that makes sense, and states read off a history
statement: For a determined law, the coarsest class keeping the map's values and carrying the law merges exactly the configurations with the same course and makes sense; a part alone makes sense exactly where the rest makes no difference to its next value; every history of values is a determined law.

title: The step index read off the relata's own courses
statement: For exchanges acting locally, an index of steps is read off the relata's own courses: it is an interleaving of them, exists exactly where a scheduler completes, reaches the configuration they fix, and is fixed by them exactly where every two exchanges share a relatum.

title: The world an interleaving builds
statement: From a local law and a list of exchanges a World of the spine is built whose steps balance. Two interleavings of the same courses, every exchange touching a relatum, are carried one to the other by one renumbering of the steps, under which what is read at a step on what its exchange touches agrees.

title: Theory of Becoming: full foundational target
statement: Target: the deductive necessity of Becoming as a whole, with no added substantive axiom: formally, every central law over every law of exchange; philosophically, its determinations as moments of one unfolding; generation, persistence, degeneration, dissolution, life, evolution, evaluation within it.

title: The threshold in the plane of level and recent giving
statement: Under an adjustment rising with what is left and with the recent giving, within a band, the runs that rest below the draw are exactly those from levels below a least level for each recent giving, decided; that level does not rise as the recent giving rises.

title: Thresholds beyond a band
statement: Beyond a band, a bound on the run decides by a finite check whether a condition of a finite web ends, and under mutual support each point of no return is exact and at most what it was as any other level rises.

title: Thresholds of waiting
statement: Where a formation gives as all but its tolerance of what it waits on gave, a set relying on at most its tolerance outside it keeps giving and a thin withholding passes out in one step; restoring needs a formation sparing all it waits on.

title: Necessary relations for a timely response
statement: For two native flow/web courses with common initial levels, prefix balance and presence, response through what coupled in before, outside a source, and a common complete readout, a distinction outside ordered propagation cannot change the answer by its deadline. Finite weighted commitment is at most paired error plus timely potential-reach weight; total nonarrival gives equality with paired error.

title: Tolerance monotone across laws
statement: For the same waits and the same start, a formation giving under a tolerating law gives under every law tolerating at least as much, at every step: a law keeping inclusion into another keeps it along their courses.

title: Step laws and endpoint traces
statement: Two processes on the same state/action types agree pointwise on steps iff they agree on all finite labelled traces with both endpoints retained.

title: Transition grouping recovers encoded word sequences
statement: For every alphabet and every adjacency relation r: reading from the right, an element joins the following group where r links it to that group's first element and opens a new group otherwise; grouping returns a partition exactly when every group is nonempty, linked by r inside and not linked to the next, that partition is unique, and grouping never changes the sequence. For a vocabulary of nonempt

title: Independence of transmission where it binds
statement: Wherever transmission binds, dropping one dependence of the giver keeps every other premise and finiteness and breaks it; so no law kept by dropping a dependence derives it, and a reading of the exchange with drawing being depending derives it, each needed.

title: Transmission as inheritance with a bounded need
statement: Transmission is inheritance with the need within a bound, a law of how dependence forms at coming to stand. Under balance descent forms no new dependence, and the evolution laws need it only at the descent they use, and there only from some supported giver.

title: The difference between two acts' worlds
statement: Under one law of what has stood, two feasible acts of the part generate two balanced worlds whose gap at each condition is at most the carried amount, attained; the laws of loops, cuts, routes, closing, frequency, thresholds and observation hold of them, and loops read off a world form within it.

title: Two rules read from one share lock together
statement: Two rules each read as a monotone function of one share are read so together; where selection under both favouring does not lower the share and both favour at every share, the pair is locked from the step after the first reading step.

title: Two-sided regulation, and regulation that reads late
statement: Opposed from both sides within its gap, which is exactly not overshooting, a level settles at m; read l steps late, every rule needs a band at least 2(l+1)d wide, which the late return keeps; a late relay settles from every start held below exactly where a + (l+1)M <= b + 1.

title: Typicality by counting
statement: Counting shows that most courses show the weights: with natural weights p and q on two values, the weighted squared deviations of the courses of n steps add up exactly to n·p·q·(p + q)ⁿ, so the courses far off weigh a share that falls with n. Which course happens lies outside what counting decides.

title: Unanchored incidence questions lose real continuation distinctions
statement: All fragments in any two joining structures with local left/right units agree in the unanchored incidence language. The coarse account is exact and reduced for that language yet can turn the same spent history’s impossible self-join into a possible one.

title: Unceasing generation needs renewal
statement: Where arising depletes finitely many conditions, unceasing generation needs renewal to recur; renewal does not imply generation.

title: One unfolding, read in context
statement: Readings in context, quantum ones too, make one world; context-free description exists just where they glue; standing and exchange read change alike just where flow balances; counting the rest, any level sequence, so any world, runs by exchange; under invariance significance stops at no boundary.

title: Stronger universal practical warrant target
statement: Target: universal practical warrant with zero substantive axioms, developed as one account of ends, selection, knowing, normativity and revision within becoming.

title: Valuing what is left at any worth
statement: At any worth above one for what is left, every optimum holds a level of greatest renewal through the horizon and regrows only at the last step, so a dependence above it is broken at once and restored at the end; a coupling of keeping is outweighed as without the value.

title: Valuing what is left at the horizon
statement: With what is left after the horizon valued as much as what is drawn, every optimum holds a level of greatest renewal to the horizon and the drain at the end is no longer forced; a dependence above every such level is still broken at the first step.

title: Completion of an in-flight request along its retained route
statement: For every partial law that, while a task is pending, does one unit of its remaining work per tick and finishes when none is left, the task finishes in exactly its remaining work plus one tick, and every shorter run leaves it pending with the work lowered by the ticks taken; with fuel counted, work + 1 ticks finish exactly when the fuel covers them. The versioned queue's head is such a task: under

title: Webs with a recent giving
statement: A web whose giving reads what each condition gave last keeps the order of states under mutual support, so its bounded runs have ending decided and each threshold exact and at most what it was as any level or recent giving rises; what was given can lower a threshold.

title: Weights count situations
statement: Where each step is taken in as many situations as its natural weight, each fixing the step, the law with the situation as the move is determined, a course weighs the number of situations taking it, and the law of large numbers counts situations. Which situation happens is not a count.

title: Weights within a ratio agree past it
statement: Every positive weighting whose weights stand within n/d of each other ranks the course keeping p items the other does not above the one keeping q exactly where n q < d p; two such weightings rank a pair opposite ways exactly where n/d exceeds both p/q and q/p.

title: 文 in the grammar of continuation
statement: Read with a law's step as 缘 and a map's values as a class, 文同 is the core of the value class and so is likeness by bisimulation; the coarsest value-keeping class is the core; the states of a 文 are its core along the steps; the bounded laws and learnability are restated through the core.

title: 文理生生 on the spine: the course named 文, and how a law is read from it
statement: 文 names a run's states read through a map step by step (Parting.course), 文同 two states whose courses agree (Law.SameFuture); the epistemology of 文 (laws read off the unfolding, 读书百遍其义自见, 理 and the 文) is tied to checked laws, each with its scope; 文理生生 is compared character by character.

title: What a center can come to know of its region, step by step
statement: From an act at step S, no answer a center gives through its couplings differs by T unless a condition coupled into it lies within T − S coupling links of the act: what it can come to know of what it reaches grows by at most one link a step, along coupling.

title: What a commuting law keeps apart
statement: Where a law commutes with a map moving every configuration, its runs from x and from the image of x are never at one configuration at the same step: to merge what a symmetry tells apart, a law must break it. The diagonal's never resting is the case of a map with itself.

title: What a cut loses, for every schedule of couplings
statement: For every schedule of couplings, a cut at order j loses exactly what j + 1 responses carry, where a longer chain in time order arrives; once the schedule settles, a finite order is exact exactly where no loop of continuing couplings lies upstream, the only way past every polynomial.

title: What a finite history refutes
statement: For every process: a refutable reading holds, up to double negation, at every run adhering to it; one with an adhering run outside it is not refutable, and one with a run inside adhering to its complement is not verifiable; refutability of every reading of prefix tests is exactly Markov's principle.

title: What a finite stretch verifies, and what none can refute
statement: Open classes of histories are the verifiable ones, with no premise; refuting is verifying the complement. Every reading is its hull met with a remainder no finite stretch refutes, dense exactly where it is decided at each stretch whether the reading can still hold.

title: What a law of the whole and no part takes
statement: With numbered conditions, a counterexample to the least coupling, like every law of the whole and no part, exists exactly where a rule decides of every Boolean sequence whether it is false throughout: WLPO as a rule. The decision of vanishing is exactly LPO as a rule.

title: What a method comes to say in the limit
statement: A method fixed by the record verifies in the limit unions of closed readings and refutes meets of open ones. Settling is verified in the limit, at no finite stretch; recurrence is refuted in the limit and, under Markov's principle, verified there by no method.

title: What a pool's acts respond to
statement: Where each member's law reads through its coupling, what a pool decides by its acts is a selection through its pooled coupling, and nothing within the pool's coupling closure responds to a difference staying beyond it. Coupling bounds the response exactly and does not fix it.

title: What a rise draws from beyond
statement: Where the whole gains nothing, the beyond falls by the rise and the loss; past the slack of the dependences there one breaks, unseen by a selection rewarding the rise; raising is reaching beyond, whose share over generations favouring raisers is never selected against; closed, the beyond bounds it.

title: What an extrapolation given nothing fixes
statement: Given nothing, a prefix fixes the whole future through the map in every world a list holds; what a learnable feature adds to it is exactly a reading of that future, so no extrapolation given nothing learns every learnable feature.

title: What an optimum does beyond what couples in
statement: Every order rising with what couples in has its optima at the least level beyond exactly where lowering it leaves room; an optimum breaks exactly the dependences beyond some outcome breaks; raising the family is lowering the beyond with the loss; keeping each dependence takes the slack.

title: What bounds offspring numbers, and selection on offspring number itself
statement: Selection on offspring number itself is its spread over pairs, never negative; offspring numbers are bounded by what is given and taken; a lineage within a family dissipated on ends within its stock, so its transmission must lower offspring number by more than selection raises it.

title: What dependence alone carries of a level
statement: At the step of the exchange, dependence alone, with activity needing support, carries of a level exactly the responses rising with it, and a fall only where some level falls; with a complement at a fixed total it carries every response.

title: What discrete steps and whole amounts represent
statement: Discrete steps represent real-valued time exactly for balance; whole amounts are not available where amounts change ever less; over real amounts novelty needs gain only by a least separation, and runaway is set by frequency where held, by strength where damped.

title: What finitely many labels fix
statement: In a world a list of N holds, a feature is learnable through the map exactly where an extrapolation given at most N labelled names of N - 1 values learns it; its labels include every value the feature takes once it rests; where the map carries the feature, labels before a bound fix every later one.

title: What pooled coupling reaches
statement: A pool's selections are blind beyond the union of its members' coupling closures and separate exactly what the members do not all couple alike. An act differing only beyond that union, the pool's own included, is selected alike within it; a formation whose admission the act changes separates it.

title: What position reads
statement: Positions in a family read the amounts exactly up to one amount common to every part. So they bound the total drawn from below, by the spread above the least part, and never from above: the same positions at every step go with a condition that ends and one that lasts.

title: What self-concern alone ranks
statement: An order that ranks higher every widening adding to its own continuation ranks a course that adds to it above another exactly where the other keeps nothing beyond it; so the ending of what everything needs is ranked below from every standpoint.

title: What taking all that is given excludes
statement: Where renewal depends on what it renews, a formation that takes all that is given and continues excludes every other taker through a window as long as the level: one living by taking ends. Taking jointly within what is given keeps all; the levels still admit the excluded where it ends.

title: What the claims do not read, the comparison cannot weigh
statement: Under BasicPriority two alternatives realizing the same claims are compared alike, neither better than the other, so a loss laid on someone by another's part and the same loss self-borne are not ordered; adjoined as a basic claim, the agent orders them.

title: What the dynamics leave open of the continuation condition, and what closes it
statement: No statement that reads only the dynamics excludes a rival or, given a standpoint and a formation, entails the continuation condition. A rival is exactly a point lacking significance; a premise excludes every rival exactly where no point lacks significance, the condition where each point is decided.

title: What the step across standpoints reaches
statement: From each standpoint's presupposition about its own continuation and standpoint-invariance, exactly the centers' continuation is forced to have significance, the continuation condition only where every formation is a center; a standpoint's own presupposition forces exactly its closure.

title: What training installs
statement: Training read as a selection over act laws through the courses each generates installs a law only along its own courses and as far as the learner's representation lumps them, through a reward only where its couplings separate, and among settled laws by the search's start and neighbourhoods.

title: When the runs of a process settle
statement: In a world a list holds, some run of a process keeps changing exactly where a reachable change can be undone; that no run keeps changing does not give settling, which is the limited principle of omniscience already for two configurations.

title: How a center forms: where a formation's acts return
statement: Two formations lie in one loop where each can affect the other. A formation's acts return, all it acts on lying within what it can represent, exactly where its loop is closed under affecting; loops form as links close them, and over finitely many formations every reach holds one.

title: Where a level couples into a formation
statement: An exchange's response to one level is a coupling of every strength array of the law. For a law reading through the couplings only levels coupled in respond; by threshold only a crossing passes, through the needs' conjunction, and coupling by level is exactly where a level couples within its need.

title: Where a move is formed
statement: One move formed in a whole couples a part and the rest: it is the part's exactly where it is the part's policy, the rest's likewise, both only if constant; every run is a part's course whose moves a rest forms; a course fixes whose move it is only where a configuration recurs with the move varied.

title: Where a rising take ends
statement: A take more than now at every step, from a condition given at most B per step, takes all that is given within B + 1 steps, then more, which balance allows for fewer steps than the level plus one: the seeker ends, no need supplied. Where renewal depends on what it renews, the renewal ends too.

title: Where a run goes on
statement: Within finitely many configurations a run is exactly a course into a return, given by the course itself, and the laws along runs hold wherever the process can keep moving; a search over recognized moves builds one; asked of every process, a run is dependent choice.

title: Where a run of a regime comes to rest
statement: Every run of an adjustment of giving rising with what is left and with the recent giving, within a band up to hi, comes to rest within 3 hi + 3 steps, at the regime's point or below the draw; whether it changes again is decided at each step.

title: Where novelty's gain comes from
statement: With the rest counted, every rise is given; under the first law a family without repetition gains from the rest or across its boundary; a finite whole the rest gives nothing net returns and is not new at every step; novelty and endless new formation need gain.

title: Where two courses rejoin
statement: Courses with and without an act that parted at a condition rejoin only across a step where they exchange with it differently, by exactly the gap; where the rest reads through its coupling, only through a formation coupling them apart. Beyond the responsive reach they stay apart.

title: Whether a loop closes, keeps or widens a difference
statement: A loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less than it received; with whole-number factors it closes at once, keeps it or runs away. Around a cycle of exact links one turn is the return map's course plus what the cycle held, strictly more for two or more conditions.

title: Which links a closure needs
statement: A cut leaves every closure as it was exactly where each removed link is bypassed, and a join adds exactly what passes through it. In a world grown by attachment every condition is needed; one added condition frees exactly the grown ones it crosses.

title: A whole that draws its parts' arising beyond its renewal ends
statement: Listed parts that each end, none arising from some step on, end with their whole; so a whole whose parts arise only where they depend on a family whose renewal is gated on it ends after the joint draw exceeds the renewal for longer than the margin.

title: The whole first, and centers bounded by dependence
statement: Fewer significant continuations retain more; under the continuation condition what retains in the whole retains in every region, not conversely. Bounded by dependence, the clearer's part retains all for the clearer, loses the dweller for the dweller, and under the condition for every standpoint.

title: The tally is the whole law of counting
statement: The tally is the whole law of counting: listings count exactly the tallies. Under each selection of the eight premises the only law added to the tally is that nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active, exactly where the selection binds counting; binding adds at most three more.

title: A whole persists through the generation of its parts
statement: Where parts are brief, or end with finitely many active at once, a persisting whole needs its parts to keep arising.

title: Widening along a reading, and over a grown world
statement: Widening compares two webs along a reading of one's formations in the other's, and is widening along the identity; a grown world widens the old exactly where the old admissions are kept and either an old formation gains admission or a new one is admitted.

title: Widening as what every weighting ranks
statement: Over a finite listing, one course widens another exactly when every order ranking each widening higher ranks it higher, additive or not, as every positive weighting does; a mixed comparison is decided both ways; a zero weight ties; one weight for all ranks by number.

title: The root of wisdom in the theory without axiom
statement: The checked laws of coupling and 识, 理, testing, learning and generalization, selection and training, enough, runaway, judgment and the meta level, and the routes of formation hold of every extrapolation and representation with the same content, axiom-free in the core: wisdom-root's formal support.

title: Core as the root of wisdom target
statement: Target: establish that the core’s common relations are indispensable across all wisdom under discussion, and thereby the foundational status of the whole core.

title: Every base read as a run
statement: A world is a run by its type: its history is a run of every step on its webs and exchanges, and exactly a run of the law they show, and every run on webs and exchanges is a world; a world balances exactly where that run follows the law of exchange, as each does with the rest counted.
